Radiology Report
Date: 09/05/2026
Patient: Sasha Wilkinson, 66-year-old female

Examination: MRI Lumbar Spine

Findings:
MRI lumbar spine 09/05/2026: L5-S1 disc herniation with moderate left foraminal stenosis contacting the exiting nerve root.

Impression:
There is a disc herniation at the L5-S1 level causing moderate left foraminal stenosis. This stenosis is in contact with the exiting nerve root on the left side.

Recommendations:
Clinical correlation is advised to assess for symptoms related to nerve root involvement. Further management should be guided by the referring physician based on clinical findings.
